title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Add turkey mince to a bowl.
Mix in egg, psyllium husk, soy sauce and seasonings.
Rest 5 min.
Form patties.
Air fry 190°C 11–13 min.
Serve in buns.

title: Mediterranean Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Prep and chop all vegetables and chicken.
Place in a baking dish with olive oil and seasonings.
Bake for 25 min.
Add mozzarella cheese on top.
Bake for a final 5 min until cheese is melted.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Steam or boil vegetables until soft.
Mash the vegetables in a large bowl.
Mix in the egg and enough breadcrumbs to form a firm texture.
Form into patties.
Bake at 180°C until golden and firm.

title: Turkey Burger Wrap
instructions: Season turkey mince and mix with egg.
Form into smaller, flatter patties.
Cook patties in a pan or air fryer.
Assemble in a wrap with fresh vegetables.

title: Veggie Burger Wrap
instructions: Prepare veggie patties as per recipe.
Cook until golden.
Place inside a wrap with fresh lettuce and tomato.

title: Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water.
Sauté mushrooms and spinach in a pan until wilted.
Lower heat and stir in skyr to create a creamy sauce.
Toss with pasta and serve.

title: Fillet Steak with Potatoes
instructions: Cut potatoes into wedges and air fry/bake at 200°C until crisp.
Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear steaks in a hot pan to desired doneness.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fluffy Keto Buns
instructions: Whisk egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold in almond flour and baking powder.
Form into 6 buns.
Bake at 170°C for 20-25 minutes.

title: Heart-Healthy Chocolate Bean Cake
instructions: Blend beans first until completely smooth.
Add eggs, sweetener, vanilla, and oil; blend again.
Mix in oat flour, cocoa, and baking powder.
Pour into a lined tin.
Bake at 180°C for 25–35 mins.
Cool completely before slicing.

title: High-Protein Yogurt Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 170°C.
Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Pour into a lined baking dish.
Bake for 30–35 minutes until the edges are set but the center slightly jiggles.
Cool and refrigerate for 2+ hours.

title: Chocolate Protein Brownies
instructions: Mix eggs and almond milk.
Stir in protein powder, cocoa, and oat flour.
Pour into a small lined tray.
Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
Do not overbake to keep them fudgy.
